heading: AI Engineering — From Foundations to Production
lede: A documented record of my continuing technical education, independent implementations, and practical engineering work across machine learning, language models, AI infrastructure, evaluation, and deployment.
standfirst: I work in marketing measurement, and most of what I build already depends on models behaving predictably. This page tracks the deliberate part of moving that work toward production AI engineering: what I am studying, what I have implemented, and what the implementations actually do when tested. Entries appear here when there is something to point at.
